rows.text: copies the 64 bytes at `rdx` (four 16-byte loads) to `rcx+0x440` through `rcx+0x47F`, then stores the float `xmm2` at dword `+0x480`, the float `xmm3` at `+0x484` and the float fifth (stack) argument at `+0x488`
stores the float `xmm2` at dword `rcx+0x128` and `edx` at dword `+0x124`; when `r9` is non-null, also copies the qword at `r9` to `+0x12C` and the dword at `r9+8` to `+0x134`
maps `ecx` to a return value: 1 returns 8, 2 returns 7, and any other value returns 9
calls `00314820` + 0x4 with the incoming registers unchanged, then tail-jumps (+ 0xD) without setting up any argument or reading the call's result
